value: {"MessageDate":"1743639054","LastDateTime":"2025-04-03 00:00:01 UTC","MessageVersion":7,"MessageAdminType":900,"MessageDuration":604800,"Messages":["YOU WILL ONLY BE NOTIFIED ONCE PER GAME ON JOIN, WHEN THERE ARE NEW MESSAGES.","THESE ARE IMPORTANT ANNOUNCEMENTS RELATED TO ADONIS AND ADONIS USERS.","IMPACTED USERS WILL BE NOTIFIED ONCE ON THEIR FIRST JOIN AFTER AN URGENT MESSAGE.","NOTIFICATIONS WILL ONLY HAPPEN FOR A SET TIME (WEEK AVG) AFTER THE MESSAGE WAS ADDED.","PLEASE READ THE MOST RECENT MESSAGE CAREFULLY AS IT LIKELY AFFECTS YOU AND YOUR USERS.","","","[UPDATE - DATE: 2025-04-03 00:00:01 UTC]","[DURATION: 7 DAYS]","[NOTIFY: ALL LEVEL 900 AND HIGHER]","AN UPDATE ON THE PREVIOUS INCIDENT:","Following a further investigation into the issue, this stemmed from a mishandling in how we dealt with command permission overrides","Specifically in settings.Permissions","This made it so if you had, for example, set the :ff command to level 300, you could have structured it as \"ff:300\" or \"ff:HeadAdmins\", but the mistake lays in the \"ff:300\"","Due to an oversight (and lack of specific testing) in this area, the 300 was not turned into a number and instead remained a string","This meant that when the system went to update its internal level, it saw a string and assumed it was a rank but it couldn't find a rank","Idealy, in this scenario, the command should be set to the highest possible rank, but it was not in this case. Instead, it was set to rank of 0 aka Players aka Everyone","This meant that any commands you had overriden with a level instead of a rank name were accessible to EVERYONE in servers with the affected version.","We are terribly sorry for this mistake and are working on restoring data to all users.","In our community guild under the Epix Incorporated group, a script to restore data will be posted shortly (or may have already been if you're reading this later)","","Going forward, any and all changes relating to permissions will undergo a strict check between multiple people and be tested thoroughly before it moves to production.","","We are going to be adding a way to undo the data-reset if you were unaffected by the mistake and a command to roll pre-incident data over to current data (like bans/mutes)","Again we are terribly sorry this happened.","I (Coasterteam), or another maintainer, will be making another Alert when the restore command & setting go live, for now I go back to working on this.","- Adonis Maintainers","","[PREVIOUS ALERTS]:","[CRITICAL - THIS IS NOT A FLAW WITH ADONIS.","OTHER SCRIPTS/RESOURCES ARE LIKELY ALSO BEING TARGETTED.","ONLY USE STUDIO PLUGINS FROM TRUSTED SOURCES.","[END_OF_MESSAGE 2020-12-29 00:40 UTC]","","","[IMPORTANCE LEVEL: HIGH - DATE: 2020-1-8 23:38 UTC]","[NOTIFY DURATION: 7 DAYS]","[NOTIFYING ALL RANK \"ADMIN\" AND HIGHER]","A ROBLOX (NOT ADONIS) EXPLOIT ALLOWED USERS TO SPOOF USERNAMES, IMPERSONATING OTHER USERS.","EXPLOITERS IMPERSONATING GAME ADMINS WERE ABLE TO CHANGE SETTINGS AND ADD ADMINS.","ALL DATASTORE SAVED ADMINS AND SETTINGS ARE BEING CLEARED TO PROTECT USERS/GAMES.","GAME BANS AND OTHER SAVED LISTS/TABLES WILL ALSO LIKELY BE CLEARED","PLAYER DATA WILL NOT BE AFFECTED.","FULL DETAILS BELOW.","","=What Happened?=","A Roblox exploit (not Adonis) allowed users to change their usernames, allowing them to impersonate users.","This also allowed them to impersonate admins, such as the place owner.","Adonis, as well as all other scripts, would see the exploiter's Name property as their desired fake name.","I have been informed that this was patched at some point earlier today.","","=How Does This Affect You?=","I don't know the extent of damage that has been done. Because of this, in addition","to a new check to attempt to avoid this in the future, I am also CLEARING ALL DATASTORE","SAVED SETTINGS AND ADMINS! This is being done due to people impersonating admin accounts to","edit settings/add admins, so I'm clearing these from the datastore to prevent potential abuse","and protect users and games.","","I apologize for any inconvience this may pose, and anything that was written in the settings module","in studio will be completely unaffected. SAVED PLAYER DATA WILL NOT BE AFFECTED. Any admins or settings","that were added/altered and saved in-game will be cleared/reset to prevent backdoor/abuse.","Again, the cause of this was entirely out of my control and was not caused by anything Adonis did.","Personally, I'd prefer not to do this but the risk and severity is high enough to warrant it.","- Davey_Bones (Sceleratis)","[END_OF_MESSAGE 2020-1-8 23:38 UTC]"]}
